modeNotes.label: Reference fixture
modeNotes.meaning: The state is rendered from checked-in fixture evidence and not from a tenant runtime.

modeNotes.label: Simulated
modeNotes.meaning: The next action is shown against mocked service boundaries and deterministic fixture state.

modeNotes.label: Live evidence required
modeNotes.meaning: A future surface may show this label only after accepted live evidence exists elsewhere.

modeNotes.label: Scope-out
modeNotes.meaning: The state names a boundary this proof must not implement or claim as shipped.

workspace.name: Snapshop Workspace
workspace.summary: Workspace exists with no project and no provider prerequisite yet.

providerReadiness.detail: Provider setup is not requested until a project fixture is selected.

safeNextAction.label: Create a project from the snapshot fixture

missingPrerequisiteBehavior.ifMissing: No workspace project fixture is selected.
missingPrerequisiteBehavior.userSees: An empty state with a single safe project-start action and no deploy claims.
missingPrerequisiteBehavior.systemDoesNot: Infer provider readiness, create accounts, or run live setup.

supportHandoff.redaction: fixture ids, owner role, and state category only; no customer data
supportHandoff.note: Support can confirm this is an empty fixture state, not a failure.

accessibilityNotes: Primary status is text, not color-only state.
Safe next action remains keyboard reachable and has owner/evidence context.

wireframe.caption: Empty workspace shows project-start action and proof-mode label.
wireframe.secondaryDetail: Start from a fixture before any provider readiness appears.

safeClaims: The empty state can point to a project fixture without claiming runtime setup.

workspace.name: Snapshop Workspace
workspace.summary: Workspace and project have enough fixture evidence to preview a plan.

project.name: Snapshop API
project.summary: Project has manifest and safe plan fixtures.

providerReadiness.detail: Provider readiness is simulated by accepted plan and Gatekeeper fixtures.

missingPrerequisiteBehavior.userSees: Ready state downgrades to blocked with the missing fixture named.
missingPrerequisiteBehavior.systemDoesNot: Treat missing planner evidence as deployable.

supportHandoff.redaction: fixture ids, owner role, and state category only; no customer data
supportHandoff.note: Support sees fixture id and proof mode, but no customer data.

accessibilityNotes: Primary status is text, not color-only state.
Safe next action remains keyboard reachable and has owner/evidence context.

wireframe.caption: Ready project shows plan review as the safe next action.
wireframe.secondaryDetail: Provider readiness is simulated and fixture-backed.

safeClaims: The ready state proves a mocked plan preview path, not a live deploy.

workspace.name: Snapshop Workspace
workspace.summary: Workspace has a project, but provider readiness is blocked by owner action.

project.name: Snapshop API
project.summary: Project has a plan fixture that cannot proceed until approval evidence exists.

providerReadiness.detail: Provider approval fixture is missing and must be owned outside the onboarding surface.

safeNextAction.label: Request provider approval evidence
safeNextAction.evidenceRequired: provider approval or Gatekeeper refusal fixture

evidenceLink.label: provider approval or Gatekeeper refusal fixture

missingPrerequisiteBehavior.userSees: Blocked state names the owner and the safe request action.
missingPrerequisiteBehavior.systemDoesNot: Hide the blocker or offer a deploy button.

supportHandoff.redaction: fixture ids, owner role, and state category only; no customer data
supportHandoff.note: Support routes to the platform engineer with the missing approval fixture id.

accessibilityNotes: Primary status is text, not color-only state.
Safe next action remains keyboard reachable and has owner/evidence context.

wireframe.caption: Blocked project names owner, missing evidence, and support-safe handoff.
wireframe.secondaryDetail: Approval evidence is missing; deploy actions stay hidden.

safeClaims: The blocked state names owner and evidence without bypassing policy.

workspace.name: Snapshop Workspace
workspace.summary: Workspace is returning from a failed or stale state using recovery fixtures.

project.name: Snapshop API
project.summary: Project has a recovery preview fixture and a support route.

providerReadiness.detail: Recovery is shown from snapshot and rollback preview evidence only.

missingPrerequisiteBehavior.ifMissing: Recovery preview fixture is stale or missing.
missingPrerequisiteBehavior.userSees: Recovering state labels evidence freshness before suggesting handoff.
missingPrerequisiteBehavior.systemDoesNot: Claim restoration or mutate live resources.

supportHandoff.redaction: fixture ids, owner role, and state category only; no customer data
supportHandoff.note: Support receives fixture id, freshness label, and redacted project state.

accessibilityNotes: Primary status is text, not color-only state.
Safe next action remains keyboard reachable and has owner/evidence context.

wireframe.caption: Recovering state foregrounds stale evidence and support handoff.
wireframe.secondaryDetail: Evidence is stale; handoff before any success claim.

safeClaims: The recovery state shows a preview path and never claims live restore.

workspace.name: Snapshop Workspace
workspace.summary: Workspace/project state has no trusted current evidence.

project.name: Snapshop API
project.summary: Project cannot show success because evidence is unknown.

providerReadiness.detail: Evidence is unknown; support must inspect redacted fixture context.

missingPrerequisiteBehavior.userSees: Failed state refuses success wording and provides support-safe next action.
missingPrerequisiteBehavior.systemDoesNot: Show green status, launch copy, or live diagnostics.

supportHandoff.redaction: fixture ids, owner role, and state category only; no customer data
supportHandoff.note: Support receives no customer data; only fixture ids and failure category.

accessibilityNotes: Primary status is text, not color-only state.
Safe next action remains keyboard reachable and has owner/evidence context.

wireframe.caption: Failed state is explicit, redacted, and action-oriented.
wireframe.secondaryDetail: No success claim until evidence is refreshed.

safeClaims: The failed state is a refusal surface, not a launch or uptime claim.

workspace.name: Snapshop Workspace
workspace.summary: Workspace has accepted evidence that a user-visible outcome was reached.

project.name: Snapshop API
project.summary: Project shows value proof linked to accepted fixture evidence.

providerReadiness.detail: Value proof is tied to accepted quickstart evidence; future live proof is separately gated.

safeNextAction.label: Share the accepted value proof link

missingPrerequisiteBehavior.userSees: Value state downgrades to ready or recovering until evidence is linked.
missingPrerequisiteBehavior.systemDoesNot: Create launch copy or imply live customer success.

supportHandoff.redaction: fixture ids, owner role, and state category only; no customer data
supportHandoff.note: Support can cite the evidence link; live verification remains out of this proof.

accessibilityNotes: Primary status is text, not color-only state.
Safe next action remains keyboard reachable and has owner/evidence context.

wireframe.caption: Value-proven state shows accepted evidence and no unsupported launch claim.
wireframe.secondaryDetail: Live label is gated by accepted evidence outside this fixture.

safeClaims: The value-proven state stays inside accepted evidence boundaries.
